insight.headline: 内容空间诊断
insight.summary: 诗性一句配四格云，场子主要在共鸣不在卖货。
points: 结构：白天到日落四格递进，文案点题；没有教程式信息链，靠画面自洽。
商业：无产品、无引流话术，属于审美向内容，转化压很轻。
情感：评论在陪晒云图、表羡慕和点赞，作者逐条暖回，互动质量高。
insight.conclusion: 这条帖赢在氛围和参与感，不是结构干货或带货帖。
insight.next_step: 下条可固定「陪一张」引导语，或加一句拍摄时段提示，抬一点结构而不破坏氛围。
insight.insight_brief: 轻结构、低商业、高情感；氛围型云帖，宜延续陪拍互动。
insight.implication: 诗性一句配四格云，场子主要在共鸣不在卖货。
insight.next_step_legacy: 下条可固定「陪一张」引导语，或加一句拍摄时段提示，抬一点结构而不破坏氛围。
insight.sampling_caveat: 基于截图可见评论样本；若未含泛祝福/水评，Z 可能略偏高。

en.headline: Content Space Diagnosis
en.summary: One poetic line + four cloud frames—the field is resonance, not selling.
points: Structure: Day-to-sunset four-frame beat with a title line; no tutorial chain—frames carry the arc.
Commercial: No product or funnel copy; aesthetic share with very light conversion pressure.
Emotion: Companion cloud photos, envy/praise, warm author replies—high interaction quality.
en.conclusion: This post wins on mood and participation, not dry structure or hard sell.
en.next_step: Lock a “share yours” prompt next time, or add a shoot-time tip to lift structure without killing the vibe.
en.insight_brief: Light structure, low commerce, high emotion—mood cloud post; keep companion-photo loops.

insight_brief: 轻结构、低商业、高情感；氛围型云帖，宜延续陪拍互动。
